summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K reporting daily ASX disclosures tied to its existing stock repurchase program, under which up to $1 billion of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock may be acquired from time to time. The exhibits reproduce information furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange on the noted dates; no new authorization, price, or expiry was announced. The program is conducted at management's discretion subject to market conditions and securities laws. Watch actual buyback pace and any acceleration as a signal of management's valuation view and support for the shares.
